sections.text_helper: Section 32.4.6 "ADC Deep-power-down mode (DEEPPWD)" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1476.
sections.section_content:
By default, the ADC is in deep-power-down mode where its supply voltage is internally
switched off to reduce the leakage currents (the reset state of DEEPPWD bit is 1 in the
ADC_CR register).
To activate the ADC, first exit the Deep-power-down mode by clearing the DEEPPWD bit.
When ADC operations are complete, the ADC can be disabled by clearing the ADEN bit of
the ADC_CR register.
Power can be saved by entering ADC Deep-power-down mode again (by setting
DEEPPWD of ADC_CR register). This is particularly interesting before entering Stop mode.
